partner_applied.scope_used: finite-grid/no-pivot counterexample normal form and exact disjoint-crossrank completion endpoint

new_claims.statement: If every disjoint physical cross block has rank at most r, then A=D+R with D diagonal, R symmetric rank at most 4r, and ||D||op<=delta+r epsilon where delta=max|Aii| and epsilon=max_{i!=j}|Aij|.

A maximal-volume disjoint r-by-r pivot gives A=D+R+E with rank(R)<=4r, controlled diagonal D, E zero on the pivot core, and |Ekl|<=(r+1)min(epsilon,sigma) when all disjoint cross blocks have s_{r+1}<=sigma.

application: For the account02/B13 r15 exact crossrank-four no-pivot endpoint and m>=23, ||D||op<1/128, the |lambda|>=1/64 spectral window has rank<=16, and any bad witness must have a physical leverage >1/32; fewer than 512 coordinates can exceed that leverage. For the actual approximate normal form, the construction yields one global rank-16 skeleton plus a zero-diagonal residual supported off an eight-coordinate core with entry size O(m^-2), but no dimension-free operator/slab stability is claimed.
next_step: Control the zero-diagonal residual jointly with the rank-16 skeleton and finite-grid product source, without raw coefficient/operator-norm slab continuity; force D'/D5 cross-volume or an affine-uniform product-bank absorption.
